capabilities: track delivery stage progress and acceptance readiness
assess schedule risk against delivery gates and owner capacity
surface data-quality gaps and delivery exceptions
trace metrics and warnings back to source tasks in Project Manager
disambiguation: Not a project-management tool itself; it only reads and analyzes data from the Project Manager plugin without writing to any task note.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later and at least one Project Manager project; explicitly has no network integration and uploads nothing. Interface supports English and Simplified Chinese, and the README includes fictional demo data and screenshots.
intentEvidence: A read-only insight layer for Project Manager that extends its projects, tasks, hierarchy, tags, and statuses
problem: Project Manager data can only be viewed one project or one task at a time, so teams lack cross-project workload, delivery, and risk insight.

relations.evidence: Project Manager is the data foundation and task-operation layer for this plugin.

summary: Read-only analytics dashboard that aggregates Project Manager plugin data into cross-project workload, delivery progress, data quality, and schedule risk views.
